text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the moment is almost upon us.<n>Hehe, I can't
wait to see how this<n>race will turn out.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I always aim to keep my usual<n>composure.
Fretting won't lead to<n>good results.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Though I hope you won't take that to<n>mean that
I'm lacking drive.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The drive that propels me isn't meant<n>to be seen. It
stays hidden, a quiet<n>flame in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm fully prepared. All that remains is<n>to calmly go
out there and win. ♪
